value.rationale: The 2023/24 paper explicitly relies on approximation for the physically relevant position autocorrelation at general lags because random doubling and halving do not commute. The noncommuting reflected-word formula answers this naturally motivated finite-lag calculation with O(n^2) exact summands and provides all rational p values, including the stationary-density resonant value p=2/3. It supplies a reusable statistical benchmark rather than an arbitrary finite enumeration. It does not claim a long-lag asymptotic or solve the critical p=1/2 open problem.
